newsitem.title: USA: Western Fidelity explores options for unit.
newsitem.headline: Western Fidelity explores options for unit.

text.p: Western Fidelity Funding Inc on Tuesday said it hired Key Capital Markets Inc to help explore strategic options for its automobile finance business.

The company previously said it is closing its retail car sales operation and taking steps to cut operating expenses. Western Fidelity is also in talks with lenders as a result of its $6.6 million loss reported at the end of fiscal 1996.

The company also said it plans to complete an audit of its year-end results so that it can complete its 10-KSB annual report and then complete and file its 10-QSB report for the first quarter 1997, which ended on March 31.
Western Fidelity finances the purchase of used automobiles for borrowers with poor or no credit, a sector of the financing industry often referred to as sub-prime.
Key Capital Markets is a unit of KeyCorp.
